composition_subtypes.role: After sorting, check if all adjacent elements differ by ≤1; any gap >1 makes reduction impossible.

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort array and verify all consecutive absolute differences ≤1. If any >1, output NO, else YES.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a single greedy mechanism after sorting. Sorting is only preprocessing, not a separate coordinated mechanism, so it is not a true multi-mechanism composition.
